subject: scripts/project_config.py: config_version 2 schema, check/doctor/migrate/init; actl refuses a project whose config_version differs from A's
objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) C4, section 2 (compatibility table, schema table, migrate_1_to_2), follow-up row 2; entry name actl per D-072. (1) scripts/project_config.py holds CURRENT_VERSION = 2, the section 2 schema table (key, type, default) and MIGRATIONS = {1: migrate_1_to_2}. Subcommands: 'check <root>' (rc 0 / 2, see 2), 'doctor' (rows, rc 0/1), 'migrate' (rc 0/2), 'init' (rc 0/2); all read <root>/board/config.json through the AC_ROOT resolved by actl. (2) bin/actl runs 'python3 $AC_HOME/scripts/project_config.py check "$AC_ROOT"' before exec for every command EXCEPT version, doctor, migrate, init (otherwise a stale project could never be migrated). A file without config_version is version 1. Lower than A: rc 2, one stderr line 'config_version 1 < 2 - run: actl migrate'. Higher than A: rc 2, one stderr line 'project needs config_version 3, this A has 2 - git -C <AC_HOME> pull' (main's ruling: A behind => refuse and tell the user to pull A). Known key with wrong type: rc 2 naming key, expected type, got value. Unknown top-level key: exactly one stderr warning line per call, never rc. Missing keys: defaults, silent. (3) 'actl doctor': prints one row per finding with severity and a fix command; rc 1 when any row is severity error, else 0. Rows: version lower/higher (same text as check); known-key type error; unknown key -> warning 'possibly retired'; <reports_dir>/inbox/acked.jsonl exists -> error, fix 'actl inbox migrate' (#158's explicit migrate); <reports_dir>/inbox/index.jsonl exists -> warning 'legacy ledger, not read by A' (no fix command; see outline question); scripts/control/ exists -> error 'retired (D-071 section 7 step 5)'; .claude/settings.json hook command whose first path-looking token names a missing file -> error, fix 'actl hooks install' (row 4 ships that command; the row text is fixed now). (4) 'actl migrate': applies MIGRATIONS from the file's version up to CURRENT_VERSION in order, writes the file (indent 2, key order kept, trailing newline), prints one line per change, refuses (rc 2, file untouched) when the file is not valid JSON or the version is higher than A's; idempotent. migrate_1_to_2: set config_version 2; add tests {"adapter": "unittest"} if absent; delete rules.roles_dir / rules.models_dir and print the sentence 'project role cards now overlay $AC_HOME/memory/role; move docs/roles/<role>.md additions into memory/role/<role>.md'; delete hard_block.paths entries ending in sync-to-project.sh; print unknown top-level keys as warnings, never delete them. (5) 'actl init': when <root>/board/config.json is absent, write a version-2 file holding the schema defaults that have one (main_branch, tickets_dir, events_file, answers_file, reports_dir, port, tests.adapter, hard_block with three empty lists) and print the path; rc 2 when the file exists. (6) session-hook.sh runs 'actl doctor' (via $AC_CONTROL_DIR/../bin/actl) and prints its rows before the opening page, so a stale project is seen at session start. (7) Dogfood: A's own board/config.json gains "config_version": 2 (nothing else; the hard_block row is main's, the tests section is 3a's); tests/control_harness.py DEFAULT_CONFIG gains it too. The schema table types the keys that exist at base (section 2 rows marked existing) plus tests (object), board.key_file (string) so rows 3a/3b/5 add data, not schema.
acceptance: A1 V4 refusal (tests/test_project_config.py, harness sandbox, scripts via $AC_HOME/bin/actl): sandbox config with no config_version -> 'actl ticket list --open' rc 2, stderr contains 'config_version 1 < 2' and 'actl migrate', sandbox tickets/ and board/ listings unchanged; config with "config_version": 3 -> rc 2, stderr contains 'config_version 3', 'this A has 2', 'git -C' and 'pull'; at both versions 'actl version' rc 0 and 'actl doctor' / 'actl migrate' run (migrate at version 3 rc 2 and file byte-identical). At version 2 the same command rc 0.

A2 V4 migrate (tests/test_project_config.py): T-shaped fixture written by the test: no config_version; rules {roles_dir, models_dir, sections}; land {...}; protected_paths [...]; hard_block.paths ['docs/DECISIONS.md', 'scripts/sync-to-project.sh']. 'actl migrate' rc 0; the file then has config_version 2, tests == {"adapter": "unittest"}, rules without roles_dir/models_dir but with sections intact, land and protected_paths intact, hard_block.paths == ['docs/DECISIONS.md']; stdout contains 'roles_dir', 'memory/role', 'land', 'protected_paths'. Second run: rc 0, file byte-identical, stdout contains '0' changes or 'nothing'. File with invalid JSON ('{' only): rc 2, file byte-identical.

A3 V5 doctor (tests/test_project_config.py): sandbox at version 2 plus <reports_dir>/inbox/acked.jsonl (one row), an empty scripts/control/ dir, and .claude/settings.json whose SessionStart command names <sandbox>/scripts/control/guard-main.sh (missing) -> 'actl doctor' rc 1; stdout has three rows containing respectively 'acked.jsonl' + 'actl inbox migrate', 'scripts/control' + 'retired', 'guard-main.sh' + 'actl hooks install'. Clean version-2 sandbox -> rc 0 and none of those strings. Version-1 sandbox -> rc 1 and a row containing 'actl migrate'.

A4 keys (tests/test_project_config.py): "port": "abc" -> 'actl ticket list --open' rc 2, stderr names 'port' and 'int' and 'abc'; top-level "zzz_unknown": 1 -> command rc 0, stderr has exactly one line containing 'zzz_unknown', 'actl doctor' lists it with 'possibly retired' (rc 0: a warning); clean version-2 sandbox -> stderr has no 'config_version' / 'unknown' text; a config missing optional keys (only config_version + port) -> rc 0, no warning.

A5 dogfood, init, session page: A's board/config.json has "config_version": 2 and 'python3 scripts/project_config.py check .' rc 0 and 'sh bin/actl ticket list --open' rc 0 in A (static test reading the committed file). 'actl init' in a fresh 'git init' dir (via -C) -> rc 0, board/config.json exists with config_version 2 and tests.adapter == 'unittest' and passes check; second init rc 2, file byte-identical. tests/test_session_hook.py: on a version-1 sandbox the hook stdout contains 'actl migrate' before the opening page's first heading; on the version-2 sandbox it does not contain 'actl migrate'; existing test_session_hook cases stay green.

verify.notes: Harness sandbox (tests/control_harness.Sandbox); every config, config_version included, is written by the case, so it does not depend on DEFAULT_CONFIG. Calls 'sh $AC_HOME/bin/actl migrate|doctor|ticket list --open' and 'python3 $AC_HOME/scripts/project_config.py check <sandbox>' per the ticket's pinned interface. Each refusal case has a version-2 positive control in the same test (a missing project_config.py also exits 2), and the foreign-hook 'no row' case has a must-be-false arm (same hook, file removed -> rc 1 with an 'actl hooks install' row). Supplements A1-A5 in tests/test_project_config.py (worker's).
